items.description: Mutable remote dataset/model/text acquisition is not an admissible governed source.
Arbitrary pickle/torch state loading without exact admitted identity is unsafe.
Patient/record identity crossing train/validation/test invalidates the split contract.
Source labels never become project clinical gold automatically.
Validation/test naming or binding defects invalidate benchmark interpretation.
Missing reproducibility controls prevent exact benchmark reproduction.
Unknown code/model/data terms block reuse or asset admission.
